review_text: We ordered the oat matcha and oat hojicha. Both drinks were very bland and watered down, we could barely taste the oat milk. The matcha tasted like instant matcha, and the hojicha didn’t taste like hojicha at all. Overall, the drinks lacked flavor and were quite disappointing. Considering the price, they were not worth it.
